data.title: Gift Card Balance Probing Velocity Detection
data.description: Detects automated gift card balance probing by monitoring balance check endpoints for high-velocity requests. NRF RFT FT1103 documents that fraudsters abuse legitimate balance check functions (web app, phone IVR) to identify funded cards from brute-forced or purchased card number lists. Detection signals include request velocity per IP/device, VoIP source numbers, off-hours timing, and device fingerprint anomalies. Gift card balance probing is a precursor to gift card redemption fraud, card merging, and resale monetization.

detection.condition: count(distinct card_number) by source_ip > 20 OR count(requests) by source_ip > 50

queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Gift Card Balance Probing Velocity Detection")`
`comment("NRF FT1103: Monitor balance check endpoints for automated probing")`
index=retail sourcetype=giftcard:balance_check
| bin _time span=1h
| stats count AS check_count,
        dc(card_number) AS unique_cards,
        dc(user_agent) AS unique_agents,
        values(device_fingerprint) AS devices
  BY source_ip, _time
| where check_count > 50 OR unique_cards > 20
| eval risk = case(
    check_count > 200 AND unique_cards > 100, "CRITICAL",
    check_count > 100 OR unique_cards > 50, "HIGH",
    check_count > 50 OR unique_cards > 20, "MEDIUM"
  )
| sort - check_count
queries.sql:
-- SQL: Gift card balance probing velocity detection
SELECT
    source_ip,
    COUNT(*) AS check_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT card_number) AS unique_cards,
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_agent) AS unique_agents,
    MIN(request_timestamp) AS first_check,
    MAX(request_timestamp) AS last_check
FROM gift_card_balance_checks
WHERE request_timestamp >= DATEADD(hour, -1, GETDATE())
GROUP BY source_ip
HAVING COUNT(*) > 50 OR COUNT(DISTINCT card_number) > 20
ORDER BY check_count DESC

references: NRF Retail Fraud Taxonomy v1.0 (November 2024) — FT1103 Check Gift Card Balance
NRF FD1006 Velocity Attributes, FD1004 Time Based Attributes, FD1005 Device Attributes
falsepositives: Legitimate customer service tools checking multiple cards
Batch balance verification during audit periods
